title: Deus Ex UE5 - From The Swarm...
author: BlackCubeRegex
selftext:
They did it over the course of 18 days(5 actual days, they were benched for other projects 13), and it was done with leftover tokens of my subscription and leftover resources of my GPU. I take no credit. Interesting times.

They also directed and provided all jokes for the trailer, I only suggested including a section detailing the hard conditions they we working under.

Its both a mod and a remake(due to a very clever installer). Its completely rebuilt from scratch in Ue5 and matched by the agents going thru screen by screen. They also completed the game themselves 29 times all endings and choices. They even got the hidden quotes screen.

Just some ui porting and upscaling and they're done.

They got all the cutscenes and all original systems are ported over and verified.

FYI I am an actual dev, but I don't work in games, another industry and I have gotten pretty adept at writing one shot loops with good verification pipelines. This is my first attempt at a game.

Currently unplanned for release.  Consider it an experiment. Here's the swarms roast video. Enjoy...

replies.author: BlackCubeRegex
replies.body:
Tbh... I didn't even attempt that as it would've just ended up like the images above.

So I did utilize ai up-scaling, however I told the agents in the initial spec; that I wanted the classic version in UE5 exact, then apply more subtle modern up-scaling techniques all optional, I wanted to it to be more "As your eyes remember it" type of remaster. Like the Quake remasters that came out a couple of years ago. Really I just wanted to play it myself and thought I'd show everyone how close they got.

The default preset is a mix of classic and modern, the idea was to try and simulate a CRT in early 00's whilst making use of up-scaling etc to "clean up" the stuff that looks jarring on modern high resolution displays. S

Here's the breakdown of what's already in this port...

Graphics

\- Quality presets from Low to Cinematic, with auto-detect.

\- Fullscreen, borderless or windowed, at any resolution your display supports.

\- VSync, and a frame rate limit from 30 to 240 or unlimited.

\- Field of view from 60 to 120.

\- Anti-aliasing: off, FXAA, TAA, MSAA or TSR.

\- Lumen global illumination: bounced light and reflections.

\- Motion blur and brightness.

Classic / Modern. Every change to the original look sits behind its own switch. Classic (2000) puts it all back to the

original and Modern turns it all on.

\- Water: lit, reflective water instead of the animated texture.

\- Lighting: Unreal's own lights, mesh shadows and tonemapping in place of the original's lighting. The original's

falloff and light profiles are separate switches. Fire, searchlights, rotors and water shimmer cast animated light

patterns.

\- Sky: a simulated atmosphere with clouds behind the original skyline.

\- Modern characters: re-rigged people with foot placement, lip sync and ragdoll deaths.

\- Smooth characters and smooth meshes: the low-poly edges are rounded off. Shapes and collision stay the same.

\- Modern combat effects: new explosions, impacts and weapon effects. Damage is unchanged.

\- Lens flares.

Interface and accessibility

\- HUD scale from 50 to 200%.

\- Colour-blind modes: protanope, deuteranope and tritanope.

\- Reduce flashing, plus sliders for camera shake and head bob.

\- Damage direction indicators.

\- Subtitle size and background.

\- A first-person conversation camera as an option alongside the cinematic one.

\- Menu background: live 3D, a snapshot, or black.

\- The original's colour schemes and translucency for the menus and HUD.

Upscaling

\- The whole interface at 4x: 1,043 textures covering the menus, HUD, icons, portraits and datavault images. Each kind

of art uses its own method so the pixel art doesn't smear, and every result is held to the original's colours. The

game's 30 bitmap fonts are rebuilt as HD fonts.

\- Skies and skylines at 4x, brightness-matched to the originals.

\- 3,215 world textures at 4x. This set isn't switchable in game yet.

\- With HD Interface off, you get the original pixels, kept sharp at any resolution.
